_comment: Copy as config.json (or point to another path with the ARTEX_CONFIG env var). This file only contains the database and skill_dir entries; LLM and other settings go through env vars or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Precedence: env var ARTEX_PG_DSN > database in this file. Pick one of two forms: (A) fill in the component fields below; (B) set only database.dsn to a full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): remove the database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty, the component fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: skill root directory (each subdirectory is one skill containing SKILL.md). Precedence: env var ARTEX_SKILL_DIR > this field > default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave blank or remove this field to use the default. Relative paths resolve against the current working directory.
